description: Retrieves a list of Shared Data from the Shared Data Store resource via HTTP GET.

constraints.statement: The Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the "shared-data" store resource URI.
evidence: The Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI "shared-data" store resource.
constraints.why_interesting: This is the core request method and target resource for the operation.

constraints.statement: The query parameter sharedDataIdList shall identify the requested Shared Data.
evidence: where the query parameter sharedDataIdList identifies the requested Shared Data.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required request parameter used to select the data to retrieve.

constraints.statement: On success, the NRF shall return 200 OK.
evidence: On success, "200 OK" shall be returned with the requested Shared Data in response body.
constraints.why_interesting: This is the required success status code for the operation.

constraints.statement: On success, the response body shall contain the requested Shared Data.
evidence: On success, "200 OK" shall be returned with the requested Shared Data in response body.
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the required successful response payload.

constraints.statement: If only a subset of the requested Shared Data is available, the NRF shall still return 200 OK.
evidence: If only a subset of the requested Shared Data is available (locally stored or could be retrieved from a higher level NRF), the NRF shall still return "200 OK" with the available and retrieved subset of the requested Shared Data in the response body.
constraints.why_interesting: This is a non-obvious success rule for partial availability.

constraints.statement: If only a subset of the requested Shared Data is available, the response body shall contain the available and retrieved subset of the requested Shared Data.
evidence: If only a subset of the requested Shared Data is available (locally stored or could be retrieved from a higher level NRF), the NRF shall still return "200 OK" with the available and retrieved subset of the requested Shared Data in the response body.
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the observable payload behavior for partial retrieval.

constraints.statement: On failure, the NRF shall return a 4xx or 5xx response.
evidence: On failure, the NRF shall return "4xx/5xx" response and the response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure.
constraints.why_interesting: This constrains the failure status code range.

constraints.statement: In case of redirection, the NRF shall return a 3xx status code.
evidence: In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return 3xx status code, which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
constraints.why_interesting: This is the required redirect status class.
